_comment: WHICH KayKit MODELS BECOME WORKSHOP PROPS, AND AT WHAT SIZE.
This is the only place the asset choice lives. tools/BakeProps.gd reads it,
renders each model from the game's own fixed 2:1 dimetric camera, and writes
a sprite plus its anchor into assets/props/. Nothing at runtime ever touches
a mesh: the game ships flat sprites that already match the grid.
px_per_unit is how many screen pixels one KayKit model unit becomes.
prop  44.0    — free-standing furniture. A 2-unit table lands 124 px wide,
which is 84% of a 148 px floor cell, so stations keep a gap.
wall  26.163  — TILE_W/2 / (4 * cos45). A 4-unit KayKit wall then spans
exactly one cell edge, so wall segments tile the grid.
yaw rotates the model about Y before baking. The camera never moves, so this
is how one wall model yields both of the room's two back walls.
